content_zh:
赵六恍然道：“我这里有军备室的钥匙，但我不会使用兵器，所以从来没进去过，不如你跟我一起去看看。”
顾青山欣然道：“好。”
两人一排排兵器架都是空的，两人从头走到尾，只在最后一排兵器架上看到一柄断了半截的制式弯刀。
顾青山皱了皱眉，又在四处墙壁上一阵查探，终于发现一处暗锁。
暗锁后面，是军营高级军官存放物品的地方。
这一点倒是和前世一模一样。
上一世，玩家们看见废弃的修行者据点，第一时间就是寻找宝物，到后来，各种方法手段都发展成了一门学问。
以至于在游戏后期，还诞生了寻宝者这种职业。
顾青山看一眼暗锁，心下就有了数。
他说道：“这里暗锁级别比较高，估计只有镇守军营的将军有钥匙。”
赵六望着暗锁有些吃惊，不由道：“将军早就战死了。”
顾青山问道：“你知道他的营房在哪儿吗？”
“这我倒是知道。”
“走，去看看。”
两人退回去，在将军营房里找了许久，终于被顾青山把钥匙摸了出来。
顾青山拿着钥匙回到军备室，圆盘上有许多裂纹，好几处纹路都已剥落掉。
“阵盘？”
顾青山心中一跳，一把抄起圆盘。
“低级阵盘（已损坏），恒定布置迷幻法阵。”
“领悟迷幻法阵的布置方式，需消耗魂力17点。”

——17点，远远超出顾青山的魂力上限，根本无法领悟。
不过顾青山在意的，也不是这个。
只见顾青山将阵盘翻过来，在正中心的枢纽处一按，阵盘顿时被淡青色的光点从阵盘上落下来，散了一地。
顾青山又在阵盘另一处轻轻一按，更多数量的光点掉落地上。
“灵石！”
赵六尖叫道，扑在地上疯狂的拣着。
顾青山心中也为之一松。
阵盘虽然坏了，但上面的灵石几乎没用过，连储存的备用灵石也是丝毫没用过。
恐怕是镇守军营的将军意外身亡，其他人又不知道此事，才会让灵石留了下来。
这确实是意外惊喜。
两人将灵石全部拣起来，一数，居然有七十五枚之多！
这样一来，营地的隐匿法阵又可以维持个数十天。
顾青山放下阵盘，拿起那本小册子，随手一翻。
“军体炼气法，
第一层：曲池、
第二层：殷门、
第三层：少商、
第四层：太阴、
第五层：枢中、
第六层：灵墟、

第七层：神堂；
领悟前三层境界，需要耗费魂力1点；
领悟第四、五层境界，需要耗费魂力2点；
领悟第六层境界，需要耗费魂力3点；
领悟第七层境界，需要耗费魂力6点”
这是军队里的修行法门，是所有炼气法门中，最普通的炼气法，和那些门派、世家的修行秘法比不了。
不过这种炼气法门也有它的好处，那就是打下的基础无比扎实，对以后冲击筑基境界有好处，并且修习此诀的人到处都有，一点也不显眼。
这真是瞌睡了就有人送枕头，不过，提升等级不是要用经验值吗？
怎么魂力也可以了？
顾青山心中一动，就看见战神界面中出现了一排萤火小字。
“完整的修行法门已出现，战神操作界面准备就绪。”
“现在开始，玩家可以选择用魂力替代经验值，以提升个人等级。”
“魂力具有独占性，一旦使用魂力，将再也无法使用经验值升级，请慎重选择。”
还真是懂得变通的，有了法门，升级就和领悟技能一样，只需要魂力了。
这样一来，魂力就变得更重要。
顾青山望着战神技艺的界面，陷入沉思。
“魂力究竟是什么？”他问道。
战神界面回应：“众生最根本的力量，来自灵魂的本源。”
“根本”和“本源”两个词，在游戏中极其罕见，代表了某种极致。
这样极致的力量，必定有它的特点。

顾青山立刻就重视起来。
经验值到了游戏后期，每升一级都需要一个天文数字，对玩家造成了巨大的困扰。
而魂力，似乎是更高级的力量，选择魂力就可以避开经验值的束缚，但前路究竟如何，谁也不知道。
可是那么多惊才艳艳的玩家，到最后都没有达到这个世界最高战力的水平，经验值就是罪魁祸首之一。

content_en:
Zhao Liu suddenly said: "I have the key to the armament room here, but I don't know how to use weapons, so I have never been in it. Why don't you come with me and have a look."
Gu Qingshan said happily: "Okay."
The two of them saw rows of empty weapon racks. They walked from beginning to end and only saw a half-broken standard scimitar on the last row of weapon racks.
Gu Qingshan frowned and searched around the walls, finally finding a hidden lock.
Behind the secret lock is where senior military officers store their belongings.
This is exactly the same as in the previous life.
In the last life, when players saw the abandoned cultivator stronghold, they immediately looked for treasures. Later, various methods and means developed into a science.
So much so that in the later stages of the game, the profession of treasure hunter was born.
Gu Qingshan took one look at the secret lock and knew it.
He said: "The level of the secret lock here is relatively high. It is estimated that only the general guarding the military camp has the key."
Zhao Liu was a little surprised when he looked at the secret lock, and couldn't help but said: "The general died in the battle a long time ago."
Gu Qingshan asked: "Do you know where his barracks is?"
"I do know that."
"Let's go and have a look."
The two of them went back and searched in the general's barracks for a long time before Gu Qingshan finally took out the key.
Gu Qingshan took the key and returned to the armament room. There were many cracks on the disc, and several lines had peeled off.
"Array disk?"
Gu Qingshan's heart skipped a beat and he picked up the disc.
"Low-level array disk (damaged), constantly deploying psychedelic arrays."
"To understand the layout of the psychedelic array, you need to consume 17 points of soul power."
——17 points, far beyond the upper limit of Gu Qingshan’s soul power, and impossible to comprehend.
But that's not what Gu Qingshan cares about.
Gu Qingshan turned the array plate over and pressed it on the center hub. Light cyan light spots fell from the array plate and scattered all over the floor.
Gu Qingshan pressed lightly on another part of the array, and more light spots fell to the ground.
"Spiritual stone!"
Zhao Liu screamed, throwing himself on the ground and picking at it frantically.
Gu Qingshan also felt relieved.
Although the formation plate was broken, the spiritual stones on it were almost never used, and even the spare spiritual stones stored in it were not used at all.
I'm afraid that the general guarding the military camp died accidentally and the others didn't know about it, so the spirit stone was allowed to stay.
This was indeed an unexpected surprise.
The two of them picked up all the spirit stones and counted them. There were seventy-five of them!
In this way, the concealment circle in the camp can be maintained for dozens of days.
Gu Qingshan put down the array plate, picked up the booklet, and flipped through it.
"Military Qi Refining Method,
The first floor: Quchi,
Second floor: Yinmen,
The third level: Shaoshang,
The fourth layer: Taiyin,
The fifth floor: hub,
The sixth floor: Lingxu,
Seventh floor: shrine;
To comprehend the first three realms, you need to spend 1 point of soul power;
To comprehend the fourth and fifth levels, you need to spend 2 points of soul power;
To comprehend the sixth level, you need to spend 3 points of soul power;
To understand the seventh level, you need to spend 6 points of soul power."
This is the cultivation method in the army. It is the most common Qi refining method among all the Qi refining methods. It is incomparable with the secret cultivation methods of those sects and aristocratic families.
However, this kind of Qi refining method also has its advantages, that is, the foundation laid is extremely solid, which is good for the future to attack the foundation-building realm, and people who practice this technique are everywhere, and they are not conspicuous at all.
It's true that someone will give you a pillow when you feel sleepy. However, don't you need experience points to increase your level?
How can soul power be enough?
Gu Qingshan's heart moved when he saw a row of small firefly characters appearing on the God of War interface.
"The complete practice method has appeared, and the God of War operation interface is ready."
"From now on, players can choose to use soul power instead of experience points to improve their personal level."
"Soul power is exclusive. Once you use soul power, you can no longer use experience points to upgrade. Please be careful.choose. "
He really knows how to adapt. With the method, upgrading is the same as comprehending skills. It only requires soul power.
In this way, soul power becomes more important.
Gu Qingshan looked at the interface of God of War's skills and fell into deep thought.
"What exactly is soul power? " he asked.
The God of War interface responded: “The most fundamental power of all living beings comes from the origin of the soul. "
The words "fundamental" and "origin" are extremely rare in the game and represent a certain extreme.
Such extreme power must have its own characteristics.
Gu Qingshan immediately paid attention to it.
In the later stages of the game, experience points require an astronomical amount for each level up, causing great trouble to players.
Soul power seems to be a more advanced power. Choosing soul power can avoid the shackles of experience points, but no one knows what the future holds.
However, there are so many talented players who have not reached the highest level of combat power in the world in the end, and experience points are one of the culprits.
